tools.name: search_jobs
tools.description: Search current robotics, humanoid, embodied AI and Physical AI roles from PhysicalAI.jobs by keyword, specialty, company, location, remote status and compensation. Use this when a user wants to discover or shortlist relevant jobs.

category.description: Public PhysicalAI.jobs category slug or name.

company.description: PhysicalAI.jobs company slug or company name.

country.description: Country name, country slug, or two-letter country code.

currency.description: V1 salary thresholds use normalized annual USD compensation.

cursor.description: Opaque next_cursor returned by a previous call with identical filters.

location.description: Location text such as California, Taipei, or San Carlos.

min_salary.description: Minimum comparable annual salary in USD.

query.description: Keywords or specialty, for example robotics controls, humanoid, perception, or VLA.

remote.description: True for remote-only results; false for onsite or hybrid results.

since.description: Only jobs published at or after this ISO 8601 date-time.

sort.description: Use salary_desc only when comparing jobs with usable compensation data.

tags.description: Public PhysicalAI.jobs specialty/tag slugs or names.

tools.name: get_job
tools.description: Retrieve additional sanitized public details for one PhysicalAI.jobs listing. Use this after search_jobs or latest_jobs when the user wants more information. The result links back to PhysicalAI.jobs and never exposes a hidden employer ATS URL.

id.description: Stable public job ID returned by PhysicalAI.jobs.

tools.name: latest_jobs
tools.description: Find the newest current Physical AI, robotics, humanoid, embodied AI, autonomy, manipulation, perception and controls jobs on PhysicalAI.jobs. Use this for recent-job or jobs-since-a-date questions.

category.description: Public PhysicalAI.jobs category slug or name.

company.description: PhysicalAI.jobs company slug or company name.

country.description: Country name, country slug, or two-letter country code.

currency.description: V1 salary thresholds use normalized annual USD compensation.

cursor.description: Opaque next_cursor returned by a previous call with identical filters.

location.description: Location text such as California, Taipei, or San Carlos.

min_salary.description: Minimum comparable annual salary in USD.

remote.description: True for remote-only results; false for onsite or hybrid results.

since.description: Only jobs published at or after this ISO 8601 date-time.

tags.description: Public PhysicalAI.jobs specialty/tag slugs or names.

tools.name: search_companies
tools.description: Search public PhysicalAI.jobs company profiles and optionally restrict results to companies that currently have public live jobs. Use this for questions about robotics, humanoid or embodied AI companies and who is hiring.

cursor.description: Pagination token returned by a previous call with identical filters.
